description: A source-linked case library for commercial-grade product launch and campaign pages. Entries capture narrative, modules, media requirements, motion, commerce, responsiveness, and reuse notes without copying proprietary brand assets.

entries.why: A benchmark for product-family storytelling that moves from switching reassurance to durability, software, privacy, cameras, environment, safety, and purchase comparison.

chapters.title: Switch to iPhone
chapters.study: Starts with adoption friction and service reassurance before deeper feature proof.

chapters.title: Designed to Last

chapters.title: Privacy

modules.title: Benefit-led chapter stack

modules.reuse: Use for premium products where the buyer needs confidence across migration, durability, software, and support.

modules.title: Explore the lineup

motionPatterns.title: Chapter progression

entries.why: A direct conversion-led product page that keeps lease price, order CTA, trade-in incentive, and specs close to the product story.

chapters.title: Model Y Premium Specs

modules.title: Trade-in incentive
